g.text: Deployment | One private lab, two hosts, one K3s cluster
Layer 3 · Frames locate hosts/runtimes; named groups below contain multiple selected resources.
This describes the recorded deployment. Placement and previous receipts do not prove current readiness.
K3s server + Docker workloads + host services
K3s · CPU node · workload groups (not one Pod per box)
CPU disks · persistent data + SSD scratch (different lifetimes)

Docker bind mounts and volume-backed service state
iot-cw-gpu · private K3s worker · same cluster
4 vCPU / 15 GiB RAM + one 16-GiB V100; no external IP
iot-model-gpu · llama.cpp HTTP/SSE · one GPU resource
Deployment strategy: Recreate; reserved GPU node selector
Docker iot-feast/online: batch materialization and original stream-push experiment.

Selected recorded resources; retained releases may have other Redis instances.
Host stop, feature lease expiry and service readiness are different conditions.
